name: Stabilised Disembarkation
community_notes: [APPROX] After an enemy unit shoots this TRANSPORT in your opponent's Shooting phase, its embarked units can disembark and be set up wholly within 6" of it and outside Engagement Range; modeled as a reactive move. The disembark itself and the placement rules are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.
